pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, multi-edged polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients on the upper flank and neck; transitioning to smaller, more rounded, and irregular geometries on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, high-contrast cream-colored pathways forming a grid of tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section but narrows slightly toward the lower extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line, indicating a dense mane structure.
